act.name: Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, 2020
act.source_authority: Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India
act.supersedes: Factories Act, 1948 / Contract Labour (Regulation and Abolition) Act, 1970 and other enactments listed in section 143
act.description: Current central code consolidating occupational safety, workplace health, working conditions, contract labour and inter-State migrant worker protections.

sections.title: Responsibility of employer for maintaining health, safety and working conditions.
sections.text: Section 23 concerns employer responsibility for workplace health, safety and working conditions; consult the linked official text for the complete provision.
sections.plain_language_summary: Employers must maintain the workplace health, safety and working conditions required by the Code.
